verdict.rationale: Namecheap's own RDAP output shows a privacy service ('Withheld for Privacy LLC') redacting registrant data, so the product does ship WHOIS privacy redaction. Nothing in the pack shows it is free, enabled by default, or offered without an upsell. missing for 10: evidence that privacy is free, evidence that it is on by default, documentation of which fields (name, address, email) are redacted, independent or hands-on corroboration of no upsell.

support.subject: As a privacy-first user, WHOIS privacy is free and on by default — my name, address, and email stay redacted without an upsell

citations.quote: Privacy service provided by WITHHELD FOR PRIVACY LLC
